legend: You are the master of an arena with n%%ZSMJ0%% fighters under your control, numbered from 1%%ZSMJ1%% to n%%ZSMJ2%%. Fighter 1%%ZSMJ3%% is your favourite—you want them to emerge as the sole champion.

Mi,j=0%%ZSMJ10%% means fighter i%%ZSMJ11%% definitely loses to fighter j%%ZSMJ12%%.
Mi,j=?%%ZSMJ13%% means the outcome is undecided and you may choose it.
